messages:
nina: quick accessibility find from QA on the Settings modal used in the Console -> Model Routes flow. Keyboard gets trapped after closing the modal — focus doesn't return to the route row or the triggering control.
maria: thanks, can you share exact steps to repro?
nina: repro: open Routes list -> click the kebab on a row -> Edit Settings -> Close (or Save then Close). After Close the first Tab goes into the page header search instead of the original kebab button. Looks like we're not restoring previous focus and the modal overlay probably removed focusable order.
chris: ugh. We currently call `modal.remove()` in the DOM and then run a small timeout before focusing the trigger. If the list re-renders (virtualized) the original element is gone. We need to capture the trigger element reference before opening and restore it on close, or focus the nearest meaningful item.
sam: extra nits: pagination arrows in the routes table (Prev/Next chevrons) have poor contrast in high-contrast mode — arrows are 3.2:1 against the bg. Also the close button label duplicates the Save label for screen readers because we set `aria-labelledby` to the same node accidentally.
a11y-bot: checklist: 1) capture trigger element ref before open and restore focus on close (or focus nearest visible row); 2) ensure modal uses inert on background or `aria-hidden` properly; 3) fix duplicate `aria-labelledby` on close button; 4) bump pagination chevron contrast >= 4.5:1; 5) add focus-visible for pagination controls and eof.
qe-bot: tests failing: keyboard e2e "routes modal close returns focus" is flaky on CI (timeout). Likely due to the virtualized list rehydrate timing.
maria: proposed fixes: a) store `triggerEl = document.activeElement` before opening; b) when closing, if `document.contains(triggerEl)` then `triggerEl.focus()` else find `row = document.querySelector('[data-route-id="'+routeId+'"]') || document.querySelector('.routes-list [tabindex="0"]')` and focus that; c) avoid removing modal from DOM immediately — keep it for a microtask until focus is set; d) change duplicated `aria-labelledby` so close button references its own label; e) update pagination chevron color token to `--interactive-600` and use `filter: none` for high-contrast UA modes.
chris: also suggest using `inert` polyfill when modal open so background doesn't get tab stops, and use `aria-modal="true"` on the dialog. That should reduce background focus leakage.
sam: for contrast I'll run the color audit and attach screenshot diffs. For the chevrons maybe swap to an inline SVG with `fill=currentColor` and change color token.
a11y-bot: keyboard tests to add: open modal -> check trap inside -> close -> focus returns to trigger (or nearest route row) -> tab order preserved. Add CI retry guard and a small wait for virtualization to settle (prefer avoiding arbitrary waits). Also add Axe scan for duplicate labels.
qe-bot: i'll add a focused regression test that mocks a routed row re-render and asserts focus landed on a stable element.
maria: plan for PR: 1) capture & restore trigger focus with fallback to nearest item; 2) keep modal in DOM until focus restored; 3) add inert to background; 4) fix `aria-labelledby` targets; 5) update chevron tokens + screenshots; 6) tests (unit + e2e) and CI axe.
nina: thanks — this will stop a lot of confusion for keyboard users and reduce flakiness in QE. Happy to review the PR. :thumbsup:
